question: Can ONE functional component (U18, R75, or Q3) reach U18 8/8 with the current-carrying BAT_SENSE path de-bulged and the trunk corridor live?

casualty_analysis.mode_1: r75rot / r75rotN seal U18.7 (LTC4368_FAULT_N U18.7->R81.2) -- the western escape of pin 7 is contested even after the sense path de-bulges.
casualty_analysis.mode_2: r75rotE2 (R75 nudged east) seals U18.8 instead (Kelvin BAT_PROTECTED_P U18.8->R75.2) -- moving R75 east frees pin 7 but pulls R75.2 out of pin 8 reach.
casualty_analysis.mode_3: r75rotNE closes both 7 and 8 but over-rotates the fanout and seals U18.2 (loses LTC_UV, ledger falls to 6/29).
casualty_analysis.U18_only_and_Q3_only: u18ctrl and q3rot cap at 6/8 (U18.7+U18.8 both open); they do not touch the sense wall the way an R75 180-swap does.
casualty_analysis.implication: No single move lands all of {7,8} without sealing a third pin. The two casualties (pin 7 escape, pin 8 Kelvin reach) are complementary levers, so the minimum viable move is cardinality 2: R75 rotation (sense de-bulge, 7/8 base) joined with a U18 shift that opens pin 7 escape while keeping pin 8 Kelvin reach.
